title: Settings
lead: Your account preferences. They concern you alone: content and permissions are set elsewhere.

security.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
security.lead: A stolen password is no longer enough: signing in also asks for a six-digit code, valid for a few seconds. You need an authenticator app on your phone. It is optional — unless an administrator requires it for your account.
security.required: Your account is an administrator: two-factor authentication is required before reaching the rest of the application.
security.noCodesLeft: No recovery code is left. Generate new ones: without them, a lost phone locks this account out.
security.restartConfirm: The previous QR code will stop working. Remove it from your authenticator app before scanning the new one.
security.enrollLead: Open an authenticator app on your phone — install one if you do not have it yet. Scan this QR code, then enter the code it shows to confirm.
security.disableConfirm: Disable two-factor authentication for this account? Remaining recovery codes will be erased.
security.regenerateConfirm: Generate new codes? The previous ones stop working immediately.
security.codesLead: Write them down now: they will never be shown again. Each one works once, and they keep working even if your phone is lost.
security.copyUnavailable: Automatic copy is unavailable: this page is not served over HTTPS. Select the codes above and copy them by hand.
security.copyRefused: The copy failed. Click again, or select the codes by hand.

password.title: Password
password.lead: Change the password used to sign in to this account.

sessions.title: Sessions open elsewhere
sessions.lead: Closes every session of this account at once, except this one: other devices will have to sign in again. Changing your password does it too.
sessions.confirm: Close every session open elsewhere? Other devices will have to sign in again.

language.title: Language
language.lead: The interface language, remembered for this account.
